## 背景

ACR-VLA 的核心流程：
1. SmolVLA 生成 K=10 个 action samples (each 7D: 3 xyz + 3 rotation + 1 gripper)
2. 对 K 个 samples 做 multivariate conformal prediction → 产出 per-DOF uncertainty features (40D CGS)
3. CRM (337K MLP) 输入 obs(990D) + uncertainty(40D) → 输出 correction delta (30D, 即 5 chunk × 6 DOF, 不含 gripper)
4. 最终 action = selected_sample + CRM_correction

对比方法:
- SampleConsensus (reconvla mode): 对 K 个 samples 算 scalar Euclidean 距离，选 argmin → 42.9% (显著高于 ACR-VLA)
- baseline: 直接用 VLA 单次推理 → 30%

   distances = ((K_samples - mean_action) ** 2).sum(dim=-1)  # [K]
